record.prompt: Add km_to_miles to units/convert.py, matching the style of the existing functions (type hints, one-line docstring), and use the exact inverse of the factor miles_to_km uses.
record.final_answer:
Added `km_to_miles` to units/convert.py:10, right after `miles_to_km`, with the same type hints and one-line docstring style.

It divides by the same literal rather than multiplying by a separately rounded constant, so it's the exact inverse of the factor `miles_to_km` uses:

    return km / 1.609344

Verified: `miles_to_km(km_to_miles(10))` returns exactly `10.0`, `km_to_miles(1.609344)` returns `1.0`, and zero round-trips to zero. Lint clean. No test file exists in the repo to add coverage to.
